value.rationale: The induced-forest filtration is a natural published graph-topological construction and Petersen is a canonical noncactus symmetric cubic example not handled by the published family calculations. A complete four-stage integral homotopy classification exhibits a genuinely nontrivial plateau despite 360 added faces, an abrupt transition from a 3-sphere to six 5-spheres, exact persistent maps, and a pure nonshellable intermediate stage. No unsupported general cubic-graph statement is made.
